jade: Quick sync — greenlight runbook for Kraken QBR. Need slide owners, canary demo checklist, and exec talking points. Draft slides: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c (please add assets into the deck not comments)

sam: I can own the Onboarding health slide. Can we collapse metrics to 1 slide? :thumbsup:

olivia: I'll take Renewal risks & mitigations. Adding ARR impact + renewal timeline.

marco: I'll take Demo + tech fallback. Need p99 latency numbers for the deck — @taylor can you confirm last 30d?

taylor: p99 on Dedicated is ~220ms for seq<=1024, spikes to ~340ms on heavy bursts. I'll add a small chart and the query that generated the numbers. Also updated the runbook with the canary checklist.

jade: Action items (owners + due):
- sam: Onboarding slide (Tue EOD)
- olivia: Renewal slide (Wed 12:00pm)
- marco: Demo + fallback slide (Tue EOD)
- taylor: Latency blurb + chart (Tue EOD)
- ryan: Exec speaker notes + 2 asks (Wed 9:00am)

@ryan can you confirm exec dry-run availability Thu 10:00am?

ryan: Confirmed Thu 10:00am. I'll draft speaker notes and a 1-pager for execs. FYI customer PM asked about Private deployment ETA — might be a renewal hinge, suggest timeline slide.

sam: Added onboarding 'time-to-first-success' metric to the top of the slide.

olivia: ARR numbers and mitigations added. Added 'commitment signal' banner per ryan's note.

jade: Solid. I'll package final deck Wed 3:00pm and circulate to execs. Reminder: put screenshots in the deck's assets folder. Thanks everyone :rocket:

slides-bot: Reminder — please publish final slides to repo by Wed 5:00pm: https://github.com/redwood-inference/qbr-decks (automated reminder).
